rationale: PDD has already gapped up 6.55% and run to 83.6% of its intraday range with price now pulling back from the session high of $87.39, trading below the 9-EMA ($86.69) on declining volume — momentum is fading rather than extending. The broad market is under pressure (SPY -0.83%, VIXY +5.39%), which creates headwinds for a long continuation, while the stock has already absorbed most of the gap-driven buying interest. Entering short against a strong gap-up catalyst with no clear structural breakdown level, or long into a weakening intraday trend near the high, both carry unfavorable risk/reward at this moment.
